result.instructions: Tools for ShipMonk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still unfulfilled, and which warehouse is each one assigned to?"; "Show me the orders shipped yesterday."; "Find product SKU ABC-123 and tell me its status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ShipMonk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shipmonk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shipmonk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shipmonk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shipmonk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List the enabled ShipMonk warehouses for the account behind this API key, with their short codes (e.g. CZ1, PA1). Good first call. API: GET /v1/integrations/warehouses.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with status, store, items and shipping data. Filter by status, search text, or updated/shipped time windows. Returns one page per call; use page to continue. API: GET /v1/integrations/orders-list.

pageSize.description: Results per page (server default when omitted).

sortOrder.description: Sort by internal order id: DESC = newest first, ASC = oldest first.

search.description: Search text, same as the search box in the ShipMonk app.

orderStatus.description: Current order status: unfulfilled, fulfilled, onHold or cancelled. Omit to return all statuses.

updatedAtStart.description: Orders updated at or after this time.

updatedAtEnd.description: Orders updated at or before this time.

shippedAtStart.description: Orders shipped at or after this time.

shippedAtEnd.description: Orders shipped at or before this time.

tools.name: shipmonk_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by its external order_key or its customer-facing order_number (at least one is required), optionally limited to a store_id. API: GET /v1/integrations/orders.

orderKey.description: The external system's unique order identifier (order_key).

storeId.description: Internal store id; from the store settings or an order's store_id.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (SKUs) on the account with status, name and barcode. Filter by free text or by created/updated windows. Results can shift between pages while inventory moves. API: GET /v1/products.

search.description: Matched against product SKU, name or barcode.

status.description: Only products in this status, e.g. active, blacklisted, disabled.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_receivings
tools.title: List receivings
tools.description: List inbound receivings (purchase deliveries to a warehouse) by ASN, warehouse code, or created/updated time. API: GET /v1/integrations/receivings-list.

asn.description: Only receivings with this Advance Ship Notice (ASN) number.

warehouseId.description: Warehouse short code, e.g. CA1 or PA2 (a string, not a numeric id).

createdAt.description: Receivings created at or after this time.

updatedAt.description: Receivings updated at or after this time.

pageSize.description: Results per page (server default when omitted).

tools.name: shipmonk_get_receiving
tools.title: Get a receiving
tools.description: Get one receiving by its external receivingKey (e.g. a purchase order number) or by its ASN number (at least one is required). API: GET /v1/integrations/receiving.

receivingKey.description: External reference key assigned by the integration.

tools.name: shipmonk_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: List customer returns (RMAs) by RMA number, status, warehouse, reason, desired action, or time window. API: GET /v1/integrations/returns-list.

return_status.description: Only returns in this status, e.g. in_progress, returned, arrived.

return_reason.description: Reason code, e.g. damaged, wrong_item, no_longer_needed.

received_at.description: Returns received at the warehouse at or after this time.

page_size.description: Results per page (server default when omitted).

tools.name: shipmonk_list_inventory_holds
tools.title: List inventory holds
tools.description: List inventory holds placed on ASNs (units kept from shipping), newest first, including released and cancelled holds. API: GET /v1/integrations/inventory-holds-list.

asn.description: Only holds on the receiving with this ASN number.

pageSize.description: Holds per page (server maximum when omitted).

tools.name: shipmonk_create_order
tools.title: Create or update an order
tools.description: Create an order in ShipMonk, or update it when the same order_key and store_id already exist. Creating an order can start fulfilment: the order is only released when it is submitted (see shipmonk_submit_order). Confirm the items and address with the user first. API: POST /v1/integrations/order.

store_id.description: Store id the order belongs to (from the ShipMonk store settings).

order_key.description: Your stable external identifier; unique per store.

order_number.description: Customer-facing order number, shown on the packing slip.

ordered_at.description: ISO 8601 time the order was placed in your system.

requested_shipping_service.description: Shipping option from your system, e.g. Free Shipping or 2-Day Shipping.

order_status.description: unfulfilled = ShipMonk fulfils it; onHold = paused; cancelled = not fulfilled.

sku.description: Product SKU; must match an existing product.

line_key.description: Optional external line key for later matching.

name.description: Display name on this line (set on creation).

price.description: Per-unit price in the order currency.

state.description: State or province; ISO 3166-2 subdivision code where one exists.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US or GB.

ship_to.description: Recipient address used for the shipping label.

warehouse.description: Warehouse code that must fulfil the order, e.g. PA1. Omit to let ShipMonk route it.

customer_email.description: Recipient email for carrier delivery notices.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 code for shipping_paid, taxes_paid and item prices.

customer_notes.description: Buyer notes. Stored on creation only.

internal_notes.description: Notes for warehouse staff. Stored on creation only.

submit_at.description: ISO 8601 time to release the order to the warehouse.

tools.name: shipmonk_submit_order
tools.title: Submit an order for fulfilment
tools.description: Release an existing order into the warehouse fulfilment queue at submit_at (or reschedule its submit date). Once submitted, ShipMonk picks, packs and ships it: this moves physical goods. Confirm with the user first. API: POST /v1/integrations/submit-order.

submit_at.description: ISO 8601 time at which the order is released to fulfilment.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ShipMonk
prompts.description: What you can do with ShipMonk here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_orders_that_are_waiting_to_ship
prompts.title: Find orders that are waiting to ship
prompts.description: List the enabled warehouses, then list orders by status. Open one order to read its items and shipping data.

prompts.name: review_the_orders_shipped_yesterday
prompts.title: Review the orders shipped yesterday
prompts.description: List the orders in a shipped or updated time window, such as yesterday. Read the status and shipping data of each one.

prompts.name: look_up_a_product_sku_and_its_status
prompts.title: Look up a product SKU and its status
prompts.description: Search the products by a text term and read the status, name and barcode of each SKU.

prompts.name: track_inbound_deliveries_and_customer_returns
prompts.title: Track inbound deliveries and customer returns
prompts.description: List the inbound receivings by ASN or warehouse, and open one by its receiving key. List the customer returns with their desired action.

prompts.name: create_a_new_order_and_release_it_to_the_warehouse
prompts.title: Create a new order and release it to the warehouse
prompts.description: Create an order once the items and address are confirmed. Submit it only when the warehouse should pick and ship it, because submission moves physical goods.
